svg.title: Mada’in Salih and Thamud: three different questions
svg.desc: Religious texts associate Al-Hijr with Thamud. The place has several historical layers, and most famous surviving tombs are Nabataean. The place’s association does not identify every structure.

g.text: Distinguish the place from the surviving remains
Al-Hijr’s association with Thamud in Islamic sources
A long history of successive groups and civilizations
Most famous tombs and facades are Nabataean
The place’s association does not make every structure Thamudic
